title: DLA category rules (Contract 3, schema_version 1)
description: Maps apps (process names) and sites (hosts) to one category. Human-readable version: category-rules.md. Rules are tried from the top of each list and the FIRST match wins; anything unmatched is the default category (Other). JSON Schema can not check that a later rule is never hidden by an earlier one, or that no process or site appears twice: the tests in cloud/category-rules-testset/ check that, and whoever edits the file must run them.

rules_version.description: Version of the CONTENT. Starts at 1 and goes up by one every time any rule is added, removed, moved or changed.

updated.description: The day the content last changed, YYYY-MM-DD.

default_category.description: What an app or site that matches no rule gets.

apps.description: Rules for agent events (the app in front). Tried in order; first match wins.

sites.description: Rules for extension events (the website in front). Tried in order; first match wins. Put a more specific rule before a more general one.

note.description: Why the rule exists. For people only; never used for matching.

process.description: Process name in lowercase, WITHOUT .exe, no spaces and no path (Code.exe is written code). It matches the whole process name, ignoring letter case and a trailing .exe on the event side.

match.description: exact: the site is exactly this value. suffix: the site is this value, or ends with a dot and this value (google.com matches docs.google.com but not notgoogle.com).

value.description: Lowercase host or domain, no www., no scheme, no path, no port. A suffix may be one label (edu); an exact value needs a dot.
